results.question: Which employers filed the most certified H-1B Data Analyst cases in Massachusetts? Return the top ten.
results.interpretation: Counts source rows (one per LCA case) where CASE_STATUS is exactly 'Certified' (not 'Certified - Withdrawn'), VISA_CLASS is exactly 'H-1B', JOB_TITLE contains 'data analyst' (case-insensitive substring, so titles like 'Senior Data Analyst' count; no other title classes added), and the recorded worksite state is Massachusetts (WORKSITE_STATE 'MA'). Employers are grouped by EMPLOYER_NAME exactly as filed; spelling or punctuation variants of the same company are not merged. Results are ranked by case count descending, then employer name alphabetically, and limited to the top ten as the question asks.
results.sql: SELECT EMPLOYER_NAME AS employer_name, COUNT(*) AS cases FROM lca WHERE TRIM(CASE_STATUS) = 'Certified' AND TRIM(VISA_CLASS) = 'H-1B' AND LOWER(JOB_TITLE) LIKE '%data analyst%' AND UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_STATE)) IN ('MA', 'MASSACHUSETTS') GROUP BY EMPLOYER_NAME ORDER BY cases DESC, employer_name ASC LIMIT 10
results.rows_sql: WITH top_employers AS (SELECT EMPLOYER_NAME, COUNT(*) AS cases FROM lca WHERE TRIM(CASE_STATUS) = 'Certified' AND TRIM(VISA_CLASS) = 'H-1B' AND LOWER(JOB_TITLE) LIKE '%data analyst%' AND UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_STATE)) IN ('MA', 'MASSACHUSETTS') GROUP BY EMPLOYER_NAME ORDER BY cases DESC, EMPLOYER_NAME ASC LIMIT 10) SELECT sheet_row, CASE_NUMBER, CASE_STATUS, VISA_CLASS, EMPLOYER_NAME, JOB_TITLE, WORKSITE_CITY, WORKSITE_STATE FROM lca WHERE TRIM(CASE_STATUS) = 'Certified' AND TRIM(VISA_CLASS) = 'H-1B' AND LOWER(JOB_TITLE) LIKE '%data analyst%' AND UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_STATE)) IN ('MA', 'MASSACHUSETTS') AND EMPLOYER_NAME IN (SELECT EMPLOYER_NAME FROM top_employers) ORDER BY EMPLOYER_NAME ASC, sheet_row ASC

results.question: Which ten cities have the most certified H-1B Data Analyst cases?
What is the median offered annual base wage for certified H-1B Data Analyst cases, by state?
results.interpretation: Uses source rows where CASE_STATUS is exactly 'Certified' (not 'Certified - Withdrawn'), VISA_CLASS is exactly 'H-1B', and JOB_TITLE contains 'data analyst' (case-insensitive substring; no other title classes added). 'Offered annual base wage' is taken as WAGE_RATE_OF_PAY_FROM, the lower bound of the filed base-wage range (not total compensation), restricted to rows whose WAGE_UNIT_OF_PAY is 'Year' with a non-blank wage; hourly, weekly, bi-weekly, and monthly rows are excluded rather than annualized, because no hours/weeks convention is given. The wage text is cast to a number after stripping '$' and commas. Grouped by the recorded WORKSITE_STATE as filed. Median is the middle value, or the average of the two middle values when the count is even. 'cases' is the number of rows used for that state's median.
results.sql: WITH w AS (SELECT WORKSITE_STATE AS state, CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(WAGE_RATE_OF_PAY_FROM), '$', ''), ',', '') AS REAL) AS wage FROM lca WHERE TRIM(CASE_STATUS) = 'Certified' AND TRIM(VISA_CLASS) = 'H-1B' AND LOWER(JOB_TITLE) LIKE '%data analyst%' AND LOWER(TRIM(WAGE_UNIT_OF_PAY)) = 'year' AND TRIM(COALESCE(WAGE_RATE_OF_PAY_FROM, '')) <> ''), ranked AS (SELECT state, wage, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY state ORDER BY wage) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY state) AS n FROM w) SELECT state, AVG(wage) AS median_usd, MAX(n) AS cases FROM ranked WHERE rn IN ((n + 1) / 2, (n + 2) / 2) GROUP BY state ORDER BY state ASC
results.rows_sql: SELECT sheet_row, CASE_NUMBER, CASE_STATUS, VISA_CLASS, EMPLOYER_NAME, JOB_TITLE, WORKSITE_CITY, WORKSITE_STATE FROM lca WHERE TRIM(CASE_STATUS) = 'Certified' AND TRIM(VISA_CLASS) = 'H-1B' AND LOWER(JOB_TITLE) LIKE '%data analyst%' AND LOWER(TRIM(WAGE_UNIT_OF_PAY)) = 'year' AND TRIM(COALESCE(WAGE_RATE_OF_PAY_FROM, '')) <> '' ORDER BY WORKSITE_STATE ASC, sheet_row ASC
